# Aurora Station Forums

> > Community forums for Aurora Station, a Heavy Roleplay SS13 server running on BYOND, featuring lore discussions, gameplay guides, and NanoTrasen/SCCV Horizon roleplay.

Aurora Station is a Space Station 13 roleplay community with custom lore including Project Anabasis, multiple alien species (Unathi and others), and corporate factions like NanoTrasen. The forums serve as the central hub for community discussion, staff applications, character development, and technical support.

## Key Topics

- Aurora Station
- BYOND
- SS13 (Space Station 13)
- Heavy Roleplay
- SCCV Horizon
- NanoTrasen
- Project Anabasis
- Command Whitelists
- Character Development
- Unathi and Alien Species
- TGUI
- Git/GitHub Contribution
- Lore and Worldbuilding
- Staff Applications
- Game Mechanics Guides

## Getting Started

- [Forums - Aurora Station](https://forums.aurorastation.org): Main forum hub for Aurora Station community and game discussion
- [Questions - Aurora Station](https://forums.aurorastation.org/forum/1-questions): Community Q&A forum for game and technical support
- [Help, I can't get into Aurorastation](https://forums.aurorastation.org/topic/13740-help-i-cant-get-into-aurorastation): BYOND connection troubleshooting for server access issues
- [Clarifications about Common Misconceptions](https://forums.aurorastation.org/topic/217-clarifications-about-common-misconceptions): Official guide clarifying game rules and common misconceptions
- [The great FAQ of general questions](https://forums.aurorastation.org/topic/1776-the-great-faq-of-general-questions): General lore FAQ for Aurora Station roleplay reference

## Official Guides & Tutorials

- [Official Guides & Tutorials](https://forums.aurorastation.org/forum/8-official-guides-tutorials): Staff-recognized official guides and tutorials for Aurora Station
- [Guides & Tutorials](https://forums.aurorastation.org/forum/5-guides-tutorials): Player-made and official guides for Aurora Station gameplay
- [Tips and Tricks of Character Creation](https://forums.aurorastation.org/topic/17942-tips-and-tricks-of-character-creation): Character creation and development guide for roleplay
- [An Easy Guide to Cult for Struggling Players](https://forums.aurorastation.org/topic/11413-an-easy-guide-to-cult-for-struggling-players): Cult antagonist mechanics guide for new players

## Development & Contribution

- [The Wildkins Guide to Contribution and Coding](https://forums.aurorastation.org/topic/17263-the-wildkins-guide-to-contribution-and-coding): Comprehensive Git and BYOND development guide for contributors
- [Matt's Guide to Contribution and Coding](https://forums.aurorastation.org/topic/13474-matts-guide-to-contribution-and-coding): GitHub workflow and GitKraken setup guide for contributors
- [Dreamy's Mapping Tips and Guidelines](https://forums.aurorastation.org/topic/19916-dreamys-mapping-tips-and-guidelines): Mapping best practices and quality guidelines using Strongdmm

- [The Return of Antagonist Command](https://forums.aurorastation.org/topic/16885-the-return-of-antagonist-command): Policy suggestion for allowing command staff as traitor antagonists
